description: Java class 'GlobalErrorRegistry' that manages deserialization strategies for various subclasses of 'DittoRuntimeException' from JSON objects and headers, including singleton pattern implementation and internal registries for specific exception types.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class that provides strategies to deserialize 'DittoRuntimeException' subclasses from JSON and headers, extending 'AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry' and implementing 'ErrorRegistry'.

classes.name: DittoJsonExceptionRegistry
classes.description: Internal registry mapping error codes to deserialization strategies for specific 'DittoJsonException' subclasses.

classes.name: ExceptionParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing parsing strategies for 'JsonParsableException' annotated exceptions, including key and method name retrieval.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the type of 'DittoRuntimeException' from a JSON object based on the 'ERROR_CODE' field.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the 'message' value from a JSON object, or null if absent.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the 'description' value from a JSON object, or null if absent.

methods.name: getDittoJsonParseRegistries
methods.description: Returns the map of error code to deserialization strategy for 'DittoJsonException' types.

methods.name: getV1FallbackKeyFor
methods.description: Deprecated method to get fallback key for exception annotation.

methods.name: getKeyFor
methods.description: Gets the key for the exception based on annotation's error code.

methods.name: getMethodNameFor
methods.description: Gets the method name for deserialization based on exception annotation.
